title: Drafts
description: Contents of ol-drafts: unsaved entry per program/session, keyed '<program>/<session>'. Values are strings because they mirror form inputs; '' means empty.

sets.description: Exercise id -> one row per set, in display order.

kg.description: Raw input text. Decimal comma is accepted on save.

reps.description: Raw input text. Reps or seconds.

done.description: Per-set tick in the UI. Never saved into LogSession.
